title: Amazon to close Milton Keynes fulfilment centre, affecting 590 workers
summary: The site was the UK’s first Amazon warehouse and staff will be offered a transfer to a new Northampton site Amazon is planning to close one of its UK fulfilment centres, offering workers the chance to transfer to another site. The company announced a consultation on a proposal to close the site in Milton Keynes, which was the first Amazon centre to open in the UK, in 1998. Continue reading...

title: Trump administration halts immigrant visa processing from 75 countries
summary: The state department cites welfare use as it pauses visa processing for Brazil, Iran, Russia, Somalia and others The Donald Trump administration has indefinitely suspended immigrant visa processing for people from 75 countries, marking one of its most expansive efforts yet to restrict legal pathways to the United States. The freeze, which takes effect on 21 January, targets applicants officials deem likely to become a “public charge” – who they describe as people who may rely on government benefits for basic needs.
